title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to target. Line 1: the array as space-separated integers. Line 2: the target. Print the two indices in increasing order, space-separated. Exactly one valid answer exists.

visibleTestCases.explanation: nums[0] + nums[1] = 2 + 7 = 9, so the answer is 0 1

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: You are given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i. You may choose one day to buy and a later day to sell. Print the maximum profit achievable, or 0 if no profit is possible. Input: a single line of space-separated integers.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Buy on day 1 at price 1 and sell on day 4 at price 6, profit = 5

title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array nums on a single line, print true if any value appears at least twice, and false if every element is distinct.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The value 1 appears at index 0 and index 3

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array nums on a single line, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum and print that sum. The array contains at least one element.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The subarray 4 -1 2 1 has the largest sum, which is 6

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array nums on a single line, print an array answer where answer[i] is the product of all elements of nums except nums[i]. Solve it without using division. Print the result as space-separated integers on one line.

title: Move Zeroes
description: Given an integer array nums on a single line, move all zeroes to the end while keeping the relative order of the non-zero elements. Print the resulting array as space-separated integers on one line.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The non-zero values keep their order 1, 3, 12 and the two zeroes are pushed to the end

title: Majority Element
description: Given an integer array nums on a single line, print the majority element, which is the element that appears more than floor(n/2) times. You may assume the majority element always exists.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The value 3 appears 2 times out of 3, which is more than floor(3/2) = 1

title: Valid Anagram
description: Line 1 contains a string s and line 2 contains a string t, both made of lowercase English letters. Print true if t is an anagram of s, otherwise print false.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Both strings use the same letters with the same counts

title: Valid Palindrome
description: Given a string s on a single line, print true if it reads the same forward and backward after converting all uppercase letters to lowercase and removing every character that is not a letter or a digit. Otherwise print false. The string may contain spaces and punctuation.

visibleTestCases.input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
visibleTestCases.explanation: After cleaning, the string becomes amanaplanacanalpanama, which is a palindrome

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s on a single line, print the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated characters. The string consists of printable characters without spaces.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The longest substring without repeats is abc, which has length 3

title: Group Anagrams
description: A single line contains space-separated lowercase words. Group the words that are anagrams of each other. Print one group per line: the words inside a group must be sorted lexicographically and separated by single spaces, and the groups must be printed in lexicographic order of their first word.

visibleTestCases.input: eat tea tan ate nat bat
visibleTestCases.output:
ate eat tea
bat
nat tan
visibleTestCases.explanation: eat, tea and ate share the letters aet; nat and tan share ant; bat is alone. Groups are ordered by their first word

title: Top K Frequent Elements
description: Line 1 contains an integer array nums as space-separated integers. Line 2 contains an integer k. Print the k most frequent elements, sorted in increasing order and separated by single spaces. The answer is guaranteed to be unique.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The value 1 appears 3 times and 2 appears twice, so the two most frequent values are 1 and 2

title: Binary Search
description: Line 1 contains an array nums of distinct integers sorted in increasing order. Line 2 contains an integer target. Print the index of target in nums, or -1 if it is not present. Your algorithm must run in O(log n) time.

title: Climbing Stairs
description: You are climbing a staircase with n steps. Each time you may climb either 1 or 2 steps. Given the integer n on a single line, print the number of distinct ways to reach the top. 1 <= n <= 45.

title: House Robber
description: Given an integer array nums on a single line, where nums[i] is the money in house i, print the maximum amount you can rob without robbing two adjacent houses. The array contains at least one element.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Rob house 0 and house 2 to get 1 + 3 = 4
